title: 4521-ESP-ANC-00-61-PS002V
summary:
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Vendor data submission instructions include electronic format and specific information requirements.
- Documents must have unique numbers and be in black and white PDF format.
- Failure to comply with guidelines can result in payment delays.
- Documents must be submitted as single e-files, not multi-page PDFs unless they represent a single document.
- All documents should be in English and use US-Customary units.
- Vendors must certify drawings, list changes with dates and descriptions, and notify of any design changes within 5 days.
- Final drawings must be submitted in both ".pdf" and ".dwg" formats.
- BOMs must include OEM names, equipment part numbers, and ratings.
- Software files must be zipped and meet document requirements.
- Exceptions for non-electronic submissions require justification and approval from Abener Teyma.
